subject: Taxes
title: Gamification of Tax Compliance
description: A fast breakdown of Gamification of Tax Compliance for builders.

hook.text: Taiwan's receipt lottery gives citizens a chance to win prizes for collecting receipts.

buildup.text: Every receipt has a lottery number. Bimonthly draws award prizes up to $300,000.

discovery.text: The lottery makes consumers demand receipts from businesses, creating a bottom-up enforcement system.

twist.text: Portugal, Slovakia, and China adopted similar systems.

climax.text: Gamification turns the boring pain of compliance into anticipation and fun.

punchline.text: Win prizes by collecting receipts. Fun beats enforcement, every time.

quiz.question: How does Taiwan's receipt lottery improve tax compliance?
options: It punishes businesses that don't issue receipts
It incentivizes consumers to demand receipts, preventing hidden cash sales
